notes: CXO_wt macro (verbatim) for weighted case-crossover analysis: builds per-patient weights and runs weighted conditional logistic regression via PROC LOGISTIC (STRATA + OFFSET). Sample data are 40 case patients' rows (Pt_ID, ex, event) drawn from the repo's Data/sampdata_scenario01.csv; a caller data step and %CXO_wt invocation were added. options obs=100 caps the captured run.
